data.title: 在原七海 · 屏幕上的路线
data.description: 七海坐在终端前核对路线，屏幕上的标记已经更新到最后一处。她按住耳机，等待对面确认。
data.action: checking a route on a monitor with one hand on her earpiece
data.promptProse: Inside a dim operations center at night, Nanami sits focused in front of a glowing multi-monitor workstation, one hand gently pressing her communication earpiece. The vivid blue and amber light from the monitors reflects across her determined expression and casts high-tech luminescence over scattered documents, cables, and mechanical controls on the console desk.
